searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he remaining work — unified movie integration and proof the awtsmoos renews every frame in time; awtsmoos.com asks that many studios share one grammar and still each rhyme. mission turn the currently competing movie implementations into one canonical ai authorable movie protocol, preserve app specific strengths, connect every relevant movie capable surface, render a real 180 second feature proof, and close only with runtime evidence. evidence already observed animator is the strongest procedural 2d/3d generation and camera surface. nesher studio is the strongest nle/export/timeline surface. video editor is a lighter timeline/caption editing surface. mitzvah studio is an object/shape/text authoring surface useful for movie construction. apps/shared/movie models seconds, explicit 2d/3d/hybrid layer kinds, cameras, keyframes and already contains a 180 second example. shared/movie models milliseconds and separately describes video editor/mitzvah capabilities. libs/awtsmoos movie core is a third partial contract. existing animator prompt to scene logic was observed to be hard coded rather than genuinely arbitrary. remaining graph 1. freeze a fresh snapshot of all competing cores and active adapter writes. 2. choose one canonical public protocol and document unit semantics. 3. make ai capability discovery describe all participating apps. 4. ensure arbitrary movie duration, not 60/120 second special cases. 5. ensure narrative, tutorial, infographic, characters, shapes, paths, particles, text, 2d, 3d, hybrid and camera motion are representable. 6. give animator, nesher, video editor and mitzvah truthful canonical adapters. 7. preserve unsupported semantic layers through fidelity reports instead of deleting them. 8. preserve compatibility for alternate cores rather than leaving three contradictory public truths. 9. add a deterministic structured intent compiler that never pretends a local llm exists. 10. 15. syntax check every touched js file and run contract/adapter/browser smoke tests. 16. re read every touched file and compare planned versus actual. 17. resolve every discovered delta or record a hard blocker with evidence. 18. leave remaining work empty only when verification evidence closes the graph.

Ideal universe A movie is declarative data, not hidden DOM mutations. AI asks one capability endpoint what can be creat
searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he phase one — chesed boundless brainstorm the awtsmoos is not confined by renderer or screen; awtsmoos.com can let one movie covenant flow through every creative machine. ideal universe a movie is declarative data, not hidden dom mutations. ai asks one capability endpoint what can be created before generating anything. any positive duration is legal if timing validates. scenes may be 2d, 3d or hybrid without changing protocols. characters can be 2d rigs, 3d rigs, imported media or semantic placeholders. shapes include rects, ellipses, polygons, arrows, paths, patches and groups. text includes titles, captions, labels, callouts, tutorial annotations and data labels. infographics include bars, lines, pies, meters, counters and animated comparisons. particles exist in both 2d and 3d with deterministic seeds. cameras include wide, medium, close, pov, orbit, dolly, crane and overhead views. keyframes address stable channels and explicit easing. audio, dialogue and music remain first class semantic data. every adapter reports preserved, flattened, deferred and rejected semantics. animator stays the generative/cinematic specialist. nesher stays the nle/edit/export specialist. video editor stays the fast lightweight timeline specialist. mitzvah studio stays the object/text/shape construction specialist. motion graphics/captions surfaces remain text animation specialists. a mobile dock exposes intent, mode, duration, contract, import, preview and handoff. ai can supply structured intent or complete canonical json. a deterministic fallback compiler expands sparse structured intent without masquerading as an llm. one three minute acceptance movie exercises every major semantic kind. rendering is deterministic enough that frame witnesses can be compared. export validation uses measured media evidence. compatibility aliases keep early prototype imports alive while new code converges. canonical public time is seconds; adapters translate native milliseconds. safe area/orientation metadata makes mobile first framing part of the movie contract. future renderers join by implementing capabilities plus projection, not by forking the schema.

Do not create a fourth movie core; converge the three already present. 2. Prefer the richer seconds based apps/shared/movie only
searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he phase two — gevurah critique: 24 improvements the awtsmoos gives boundless light a measured gate; awtsmoos.com tests each bright idea against runtime fate. 1. do not create a fourth movie core; converge the three already present. 2. prefer the richer seconds based apps/shared/movie only after current import/runtime tests confirm it. 3. add video editor and mitzvah studio to canonical capabilities. 4. model app strengths separately from shared semantic support so unified does not mean fake parity. 5. give every adapter a projection report so unsupported data is never silently discarded. 6. keep canonical public timing in seconds and translate milliseconds only at adapter boundaries. 7. validate layer duration against scene duration, not merely layer start. 8. validate keyframe ranges and channels so ai authored motion cannot fail silently. 9. validate identity scope clearly and reject duplicate ids where ambiguity would break editing. 10. preserve cast and asset references with stable ids. 11. include audio/dialogue/media semantics where native editors already support them. 12. do not claim natural language ai understanding without a model provider; expose truthful structured intent plus json contract. 13. let an injected ai callback compile free form prompts when one is actually available. 14. keep mobile controls thumb reachable, safe area aware and large enough to touch. 15. make every ten second proof scene visibly distinct rather than metadata only. 16. vary cameras, transitions, charts, particles, characters, shapes and worlds across the proof. 17. render acceptance media at an efficient profile such as 640x360/12fps while keeping production apis resolution independent. 18. measure final media duration with ffprobe rather than inferring it from requested frames. 19. capture distant frame hashes/screenshots to prove the movie is not one repeated frame. 20. avoid rewriting animator's heavily active command, camera, character and mobile internals unless unavoidable. 21. hash gate every existing shared file rewrite because peers are writing concurrently. 22. run syntax and module import checks before browser tests. 23. preserve compatibility with prototype cores through translators/re exports rather than destructive deletion during active work. 24. after verification, reread every touched source and resolve planned versus actual delta before completion.

Winning architecture One canonical awtsmoos movie v1 JSON document in apps/shared/movie, expressed in seconds, wi
searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he phase two improved brainstorm — tiferes integration the awtsmoos joins chesed and gevurah in one living design; awtsmoos.com keeps freedom, truth and app personality aligned. winning architecture one canonical awtsmoos movie v1 json document in apps/shared/movie, expressed in seconds, with explicit 2d/3d/hybrid layer kinds, camera semantics, cast/assets, scenes, safe area format, keyframes and handoff metadata. each app owns an adapter. adapters never mutate the canonical document. they return native projections plus a machine readable fidelity report. animator preserves the widest cinematic semantic set; nesher converts editable media semantics into professional timeline tracks; video editor gives a fast simple timeline/caption projection; mitzvah studio projects shapes/text/objects into authoring objects while clearly deferring unsupported film semantics. ai gets two honest entrances: 1. full canonical json generated by an external model using aimoviecontract(). 2. sparse structured intent expanded deterministically by a local compiler for narrative, tutorial, infographic and hybrid templates. natural language text may be carried as prompt, but local code must not pretend it understood arbitrary semantics without an injected model callback. the 180 second acceptance movie remains the executable specification. it must validate, project into every app and render through a real visual path. proof is complete only when produced media measures about 180 seconds and sampled frames differ materially. compatibility code translates or re exports alternate prototypes; it must not preserve three incompatible canonical claims indefinitely.

searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he phase two specific execution plan 1. re snapshot competing source hashes after concurrent peer writes settle. 2. run isolated import/smoke tests against each core candidate. 3. canonicalize on apps/shared/movie if richer contract tests pass; otherwise revise the decision with evidence. 4. fully rewrite canonical capabilities to include animator, nesher, video editor, mitzvah and motion graphics personalities. 5. add small projection report and structured intent modules under canonical shared movie. 6. add or converge adapters without touching unrelated app internals. 7. extend validator for layer timing, keyframes and exact acceptance safety. 8. add compatibility translation for millisecond prototype documents only where import tracing proves need. 9. improve mobile dock with mode, duration, intent controls and an injectable ai callback. 10. keep each source file under 120 lines, tabs only, full jsdoc and b"h header. 11. build verification scripts for arbitrary durations, all semantic kinds, all adapters and the 180 second example. 12. build a browser proof renderer only if no existing renderer can faithfully consume the canonical document. 13. render actual 180 second media. 14. ffprobe output and sample multiple distant frames. 15. browser smoke the mobile dock at a narrow viewport. 16. full reread and delta ledger; run a second write pass if anything is missing. 17. final regression and completion gate.
